items.title: Cable Beach camel bucks tourists off during sunset ride

children.content: Two people were bucked off one of Broome's camels during a ride on Cable Beach, in Western Australia's far north, over the weekend.
Footage shows two people trying to hold onto the camel on Saturday evening after the spooked animal broke away from the rest of the group.
The couple are flung from the camel and hit the hard sand, as it continues to buck up and down.
A St John Ambulance spokesperson said paramedics took a woman in her 60s to Broome Hospital, under priority two conditions, which indicates a serious injury.
